# Contract: Payments collection API

This collection exposes no custom route — it relies entirely on Payload's auto-generated REST
and GraphQL CRUD for the `payments` slug, and on the Local API for server-side callers. Field
shapes live in [`data-model.md`](../data-model.md); this file documents access behavior only.

## REST (auto-generated by Payload)

| Method   | Path                | Access gate     | Behavior                                                                                                     |
| -------- | ------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `GET`    | `/api/payments`     | `authenticated` | List, paginated. `401`/empty for a non-staff or unauthenticated caller.                                      |
| `GET`    | `/api/payments/:id` | `authenticated` | Read one.                                                                                                    |
| `POST`   | `/api/payments`     | `authenticated` | Create. Rejects (`400`) on missing required field, non-select `paymentMethod`, or non-integer/`<1` `amount`. |
| `PATCH`  | `/api/payments/:id` | `authenticated` | Update. Same validation as create.                                                                           |
| `DELETE` | `/api/payments/:id` | `authenticated` | Delete.                                                                                                      |

`authenticated` (`src/access/authenticated.ts`) requires `user?.collection === 'users'` — a
signed-in `students` principal is rejected the same as an anonymous caller (see
INVARIANTS.md "An access predicate for a staff-only collection must check `user.collection`,
not `Boolean(user)`").

## GraphQL

Standard Payload-generated `payments`, `payment`, `createPayment`, `updatePayment`,
`deletePayment` operations, under the same `authenticated` gate.

## Local API

`payload.find/findByID/create/update/delete({ collection: 'payments', ... })`, used by any
future server-side caller (e.g. an enrollment-status calculation). `overrideAccess` defaults
to `true` on the Local API — any caller that must respect staff-only access explicitly passes
`overrideAccess: false`.
